Where did the attack take place on Friday in Samaria – in what type of area?

I marked the spot where the attack happened with a red dot on an official map of Israel that indicates the types of areas:
Brown – Area A
Yellow – Area B
Gray – Area C

The division into areas was determined as part of the Oslo Accords over 30 years ago.

Area A, according to the definition of the Oslo Accords, is an area under both security and civil control of the Palestinian Authority – this area is marked in brown and Israelis are prohibited from entering – the village of Tel is in Area A.

Area B is an area under civil (municipal) responsibility of the Palestinian Authority but under Israeli security control – this area is not prohibited for Israelis. Israelis are allowed to enter it.

Area C – is an area under both Israeli security and civil control.

The bottom line: the attack was carried out in Area B, which is under Israeli security control – Israelis are allowed to enter there.
